clips.title: The story
paras: Gilthares Firebough waits in a tower at Northwatch Hold, held captive by Theramore. Once a deckhand on a moonshine transport between Ratchet and Booty Bay, he seeks a chance to escape.

Gilthares Firebough is held in a tower at Northwatch Hold. His ship carried illicit cargo between Ratchet and Booty Bay when naval forces from Theramore blasted it to splinters. The sole survivor, Gilthares was dragged ashore in chains and locked away. He wears vivid red and bears little affection for the Alliance zealots who slaughtered his crew. Still, he cares little who helps him break free, so long as they can fight their way down from the ramparts.
